description: Default AX Harness capability vocabulary. Reads are broad, writes are narrow and reviewed, and the five high-impact capabilities are denied to every role.

capabilities.title: Read repository code
capabilities.description: Read source, tests, and configuration in the working repository.

capabilities.title: Read documentation and context
capabilities.description: Read the Markdown context a project declares, plus repository documentation.

capabilities.title: Read GitHub metadata
capabilities.description: Read repository metadata, commits, issues, pull requests, CI status, and workflow results.

capabilities.title: Read database metadata
capabilities.description: Inspect schema, tables, columns, indexes, and constraints. Never row data, and never writes.

capabilities.title: Run declared quality commands
capabilities.description: Run the build, lint, typecheck, or test commands the project declared. No other command is implied.

capabilities.title: Edit an isolated worktree
capabilities.description: Modify files on a working branch. Never on the default branch, and never in someone else's checkout.

capabilities.title: Create a working branch
capabilities.description: Create and push a feature branch that no protected ruleset governs.

capabilities.title: Comment on an issue or pull request
capabilities.description: Add review comments. Comments are visible to others, so they are a write, not a read.

capabilities.title: Open a pull request
capabilities.description: Propose changes for review. High impact because it asks other people to act.

capabilities.title: Write to a database
capabilities.description: Insert, update, delete, or migrate data. Denied in v1; database access is metadata-only.

capabilities.title: Push directly to the default branch
capabilities.description: Denied in v1. Changes reach the default branch through a reviewed pull request.

capabilities.title: Force push
capabilities.description: Denied in v1, because it can destroy history that other people depend on.

capabilities.title: Deploy to production
capabilities.description: Denied in v1. Deployment stays a human action outside the harness.

capabilities.title: Read secrets
capabilities.description: Denied in v1. Credentials never enter configuration, context, agent output, or diagnostics.
